summary: Report a peer's unsigned refusal of a replication exchange by its HTTP status and a fixed reason, instead of as a missing x-st3-fleet header, so st replication status says why an exchange carried nothing

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; members may upgrade in any order.

compatibility.detail: A peer's last_error for an unsigned non-success answer now names the status (for example 'refused the exchange with an unsigned 400 Bad Request: it could not read the request body') instead of 'the signed message has no valid x-st3-fleet header'. An unsigned body is never trusted or quoted; an unsigned success is still rejected. No wire change.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing is persisted.
